title: Stop at the aldehyde
hook: Predict the product, then compare the bonds.

knows: Structural formula bonds and common organic functional groups.
doesNotKnow: PCC oxidizes this primary alcohol to an aldehyde. The oxygen-bearing carbon changes from CH₂–OH to CH=O, forming ethanal under these conditions.

misconception: Reaction conditions do not affect the connectivity of the product.
objective: Predict the organic product of ethanol under the stated conditions and identify the changed connectivity.

claims.text: Question, structural diagrams, product and explanation: Ethanol is treated with PCC in a dry solvent. Which major organic product forms after workup? PCC oxidizes this primary alcohol to an aldehyde. The oxygen-bearing carbon changes from CH₂–OH to CH=O, forming ethanal under these conditions.
The diagrams use condensed labels and depict connectivity rather than molecular geometry; highlighting identifies selected changed groups.
